description: This file defines the StructureShape class within the AWS SDK for PHP, representing a structure shape and resolving member shape references in the API schema.

classes.name: StructureShape
classes.description: Represents a structure shape and resolve member shape references.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the StructureShape with a definition array and shape map, setting type to 'structure'.

methods.name: getMembers
methods.description: Returns a list of all member shapes; generates the hash if not already created.

methods.name: hasMember
methods.description: Checks if a member with the given name exists.

methods.name: getMember
methods.description: Retrieves a specific member shape by name, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: generateMembersHash
methods.description: Populates the members hash from definitions.
